name: Dataflex Software GmbH
summary: Dataflex Software GmbH is an Austrian company specializing in software solutions for the glass industry. They offer a range of products, including FlexinoLight, Flexino, FlexaroLight, and Flexaro, designed to cater to businesses of all sizes, from micro-enterprises to growing glass companies. Their software aims to provide efficient organization, scalability, and comprehensive control for glass professionals.

name: Label Software
summary: Label Software provides comprehensive business management solutions for trade companies, specializing in digitalization for the craft sector. Their core product, Labelwin, is a complete administrative solution for organizing and managing trade businesses, particularly in plumbing, heating, electrical, cooling/air conditioning, solar, and plant construction. They also offer a configurator called "mobile offer" for rapid quote generation and consulting services to guide businesses through digital transformation.

name: Finago (formerly Heeros)
summary: Finago, formerly Heeros, is a software company that provides business management solutions. Their offerings include financial management software (accounting, invoicing), HR and payroll systems, and project management tools (Finago PSA) for expert companies. They aim to automate business processes and improve efficiency for small and medium-sized enterprises.

name: IBTG GmbH
summary: IBTG GmbH is a German company specializing in the development of custom software solutions and adapted standard software for energy supply companies (EVUs). They focus on optimizing business processes and digitalization, particularly in areas like accounting and document management. IBTG also develops industry-specific software for energy providers focusing on contracting, decentralized generation and supply, combined heat and power, and biogas.

name: Shipbuilder Software
summary: Shipbuilder Software is a maritime knowledge partner that provides integrated software solutions for the maritime industry. With over 25 years of experience, they help companies specify, design, build, and maintain vessels more efficiently by structuring project data. Their software aims to reduce search time, prevent errors, and enable earlier project delivery, supporting digital transformation and data-driven operations.

name: Dolphin Software
summary: Dolphin Software is a Georgian company founded in 2004, specializing in providing comprehensive software solutions for microfinance institutions. Their flagship product, LoanKeeper, is designed to support the growth and innovation of credit companies by offering a reliable, practical, and all-encompassing system. The company aims to be a leader in financial technology by continuously innovating and setting industry standards.

name: Mysoftlabs
summary: Mysoftlabs is a global digital IT solutions provider specializing in digital transformation, automation, cloud computing, application development, cybersecurity, and embedded software services. They leverage AI, machine learning, and data engineering to help over 100 companies re-engineer processes, improve efficiency, and make data-driven decisions. Their mission is to be a top digital service provider by 2025, partnering with clients to evolve their digital strategies.

name: Tjaldur Software Governance Solutions
summary: Tjaldur Software Governance Solutions is a company specializing in software governance and license compliance engineering, with a focus on GNU GPL and LGPL licenses. They aim to simplify software governance through effective processes, tools, and mindset, leveraging their extensive experience since 2005 to help companies resolve compliance issues and prevent legal disputes. Their vision is to make software governance straightforward and transparent.

name: Waterloo Manufacturing Software
summary: Waterloo Manufacturing Software provides advanced planning and scheduling (APS) software, specifically their TACTIC product, designed for manufacturing companies. Their software helps businesses improve production scheduling, enhance delivery performance, reduce costs, and gain better visibility into their operations. TACTIC integrates with existing ERP/MRP systems to manage complex production schedules, optimize resource allocation, and respond to changes effectively.

name: B1 Consulting bv
summary: B1 Consulting bv is an IT consultancy firm providing professional services to various organizations. They specialize in project management, IT architecture, system implementation, and ICT consultancy, with a focus on delivering tailored solutions for complex IT environments. Their expertise spans areas like cloud migration, data management, enterprise service bus solutions, and digital asset management.

name: 云坞科技 (Cloudock)
summary: Cloudock Technology specializes in data migration and disaster recovery solutions, leveraging advanced block-level real-time data synchronization and replication technology. They offer a comprehensive platform supporting various data types, including full system migration, CDP disaster recovery, data and application high availability, and object/database synchronization. Their solutions cater to data centers and cloud service providers, aiming to enhance data services and operational resilience.

name: Cruise IT Services
summary: Cruise IT Services is a privately owned IT full-service provider established in 2004, based in Austria. They offer comprehensive IT solutions for cruise and cargo ships, as well as small to medium-sized companies, specializing in IT infrastructure, network, security, cloud migration, and MS 365 services. Their mission is to allow clients to focus on their core business by outsourcing all IT matters to professionals, acting as IT consultants, solution providers, and competence centers.

name: Consensus
summary: Consensus is a technology solutions and talent provider that builds high-performance teams and develops cutting-edge software solutions. They specialize in automation, hyperautomation, and cloud services, offering services such as RPA, AI/ML, cloud migration, and API integration. The company focuses on delivering tailored solutions and high-talent teams to help clients achieve their business objectives and digital transformation goals.

name: INFOKALL Solutions Sdn Bhd
summary: INFOKALL Solutions Sdn Bhd is an IT services company specializing in delivering tailored IT solutions and skillset deployment. They offer Application Management Services (AMS) support, SAP resource augmentation, and digital transformation services including cloud migration, IT infrastructure, and cybersecurity. The company aims to empower businesses to thrive in the digital world by providing expert IT consulting and transformation services across various industries.

name: INTEGR-IT
summary: INTEGR-IT specializes in designing, deploying, and maintaining robust IT infrastructure, cloud solutions, and cybersecurity services. They offer expertise in server and network management, cloud migration (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), vulnerability assessment, and data protection. The company also provides telecommunication solutions, including VoIP and enterprise network management, alongside digital services like campaign optimization and SEO strategies.

name: ПРОМАЙН (PROMAIN)
summary: PROMAIN is a group of companies specializing in the development and implementation of complex software solutions, deep business process analysis, and IT consulting. They offer services such as business process analysis, data analytics, AI/ML, cloud migration, and low-code platform development. With 20 years of market experience, they aim to create digital futures by challenging industry giants with their proprietary products and algorithms.

name: Melonleaf Consulting
summary: Melonleaf Consulting is a global technology and digital transformation company specializing in IT services, Salesforce consulting, cloud and DevOps solutions, and AI services. They help businesses innovate their work processes through custom solutions, aiming to reduce manual involvement and adopt AI. The company offers services such as Salesforce implementation, cloud migration, data engineering, and AI integration, serving various industries worldwide.

name: Skaylink GmbH
summary: Skaylink is a European specialist in digital transformation and cloud solutions, focusing on implementing digital strategies into innovative cloud environments. They offer a comprehensive range of services including cloud strategy, infrastructure, migration, modern workplace solutions, application innovation, data analytics, AI, cloud security, and managed services. Skaylink partners with clients across various industries to accelerate their time-to-value and achieve their cloud journey goals.

name: Datavail
summary: Datavail is a technology services company specializing in data analytics, AI/ML, cloud solutions, and application management. They help businesses modernize their IT environments to become AI-enabled, focusing on delivering outcomes like uptime, speed, cost efficiency, and AI readiness. Their services span data integration, cloud migration, database management, and Oracle application support, serving various industries.

name: Tape Ark
summary: Tape Ark is a global expert in tape to cloud migration, specializing in liberating data from legacy tape formats to modern cloud storage. They offer comprehensive data management services, including media audits, tape virtualization, data ingest, and AI/ML services to unlock the value of archived data for analytics and large language models. Their mission is to help organizations maximize their data's potential by providing secure, efficient, and cloud-agnostic solutions.

name: 阿里云 (Alibaba Cloud)
summary: Alibaba Cloud is a leading cloud computing company offering a comprehensive suite of cloud services, including computing, storage, networking, databases, big data analytics, and AI. It provides solutions for various industries, aiming to make cloud computing accessible and beneficial for businesses of all sizes. The company is a major player in the global cloud market, known for its robust infrastructure and innovative technologies.

name: Agile Robots SE
summary: Agile Robots SE is a company specializing in AI-driven robotics and automation solutions for industries such as automotive, consumer electronics, and healthcare. Founded in 2018 by robotics researchers, it has grown into a global leader by integrating artificial intelligence with robotics to create intelligent automation. The company focuses on delivering high-quality, fast time-to-market solutions and is expanding its offerings with products like the humanoid robot Agile ONE.

name: BitFlow GmbH
summary: BitFlow GmbH is a German company specializing in technical due diligence, IT audits, and strategic business development for tech investments. They bridge the gap between technology and business for investors and entrepreneurs, offering services like technical due diligence for IT companies, open-source license checks, and cybersecurity audits. Their mission is to provide clear, fact-based assessments and actionable recommendations to reduce investment risks and optimize technology for businesses.

name: ForgeRock AS
summary: ForgeRock AS is a technology company specializing in identity and access management solutions. They provide a platform that enables organizations to manage digital identities, secure access to applications and data, and ensure compliance. Their offerings cater to a wide range of industries seeking robust identity governance and administration.

name: dig8ital
summary: dig8ital is a company specializing in cybersecurity solutions, offering services such as cyber security strategy, transformation, cloud security, and risk management. They aim to build cyber resilience for organizations by adopting innovative, comprehensive, strategic, and pragmatic approaches. The company partners with executives and business leaders across various industries to provide expert strategic advice in the digital ecosystem.

name: a1 medical GmbH
summary: a1 medical GmbH is a German company founded in 2012, specializing in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of high-quality surgical and microsurgical instruments for ophthalmology. They offer a product range of over 3,000 items, including reusable stainless steel and titanium instruments, with a focus on quality and innovation, evidenced by their MDR certification. The company is based in Tuttlingen, a region known for medical technology.

name: BEG Bürkle GmbH & Co. KG
summary: BEG Bürkle GmbH & Co. KG is a leading manufacturer of industrial PC solutions, known as BEGits, with over 40 years of experience. They specialize in designing and producing innovative, customized industrial PCs for global deployment, focusing on principles of innovation, sustainability, customer benefit, and satisfaction. The company offers a full lifecycle support for their products, from concept to production and beyond.

name: CNC Aktepe
summary: CNC Aktepe specializes in precision CNC machining and the manufacturing of heavy-duty telescopic slides, marketed under the "made in germany" quality seal. They offer a range of services including series production, small-batch manufacturing, and assembly, catering to various industries that require high-load capacity and stable components. The company emphasizes quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction, positioning itself as a professional partner for industrial and craft applications.

name: Firat Dönerproduktion Bochum
summary: Firat Dönerproduktion Bochum, established in 1994 and located in the Ruhr area, specializes in the production and distribution of döner meat. They offer a variety of döner skewers, including Iskender, Hindi, Tavuk, Kusbasi, and Dana Yaprak, with a focus on quality and tradition. The company emphasizes that their milk-marinated skewers are phosphate-free and highlights their commitment to trust in their meat products.

name: Hörr Präzisions-Metalltechnik GmbH
summary: Hörr Präzisions-Metalltechnik GmbH, founded in 1991, specializes in the CNC turning and milling of precision metal parts. With 18 employees operating in a two-shift system, the company is a certified operation since 2000, ensuring high-quality production for its clients. Their primary goal is to provide friendly, professional, and first-class service to customers in various industries.

name: Ewald Kaufmann GmbH & Co. KG
summary: Ewald Kaufmann GmbH & Co. KG specializes in the production of high-precision micro turned parts, contact pins, and inserts. They offer a range of complementary services including parts cleaning, vibratory finishing, heat treatment, surface finishing, and assembly. Serving diverse industries such as automotive, electronics, medical technology, and mechanical engineering, the company emphasizes quality and precision in its manufacturing processes.

name: Kerling Kunststofftechnik GmbH
summary: Kerling Kunststofftechnik GmbH is a German company specializing in the manufacturing of complex plastic injection molded parts and metal processing. With over half a century of experience, they work with various thermoplastics, high-filled compounds, and high-temperature materials. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and environmental responsibility, holding ISO 14001 and ISO 50001 certifications and operating climate-neutrally.

name: KÜBLER ESSIG GmbH
summary: KÜBLER ESSIG GmbH is a technology partner specializing in the redesign and optimization of manufacturing processes through factory automation and mechanical/plant engineering. They develop and manufacture custom automation solutions, technologies, process steps, assemblies, and complete machines and plants. Under its brand BOLD.ENERGY, the company also offers solutions in renewable energies, including PV power generation, energy storage, e-mobility charging, heat pumps, and energy management.

name: Murtfeldt Additive Solutions GmbH
summary: Murtfeldt Additive Solutions GmbH appears to be a company involved in 3D printing solutions, indicated by the upload prompt for 3D data and the company name. The website also features a 404 error page, newsletter signup, social media links, and cookie consent, suggesting a functional online presence for a business operating in the additive manufacturing sector.

name: Robert E. Huber GmbH
summary: Robert E. Huber GmbH specializes in the manufacturing of precision mechanical products and components, with a particular focus on producing high-quality writing instruments and accessories for renowned global brands. They offer a range of services including assembly, product outfitting, logistics, material sourcing, and project management, leveraging unique processes and modern quality standards. The company emphasizes innovation, tradition, and technical expertise in its operations.

name: Hans Rivoir GmbH
summary: Hans Rivoir GmbH is a German family-owned company specializing in the high-quality manufacturing of jewelry. They combine traditional craftsmanship with modern techniques, offering services like OEM project development, diamond sourcing (natural and lab-grown), and expertise in enamel work. The company produces over 20,000 jewelry pieces annually, positioning itself as a quality leader in the industry.

name: Roman Vogler Steinmetzbetrieb
summary: This company is a traditional master stonemasonry business with a family history dating back to 1860. They specialize in designing and manufacturing gravestones, steles, fountains, stairs, and terraces, offering custom solutions in natural stone. They also provide services in the construction and garden sectors, emphasizing quality and design.

name: STENG LICHT
summary: STENG LICHT, operating as STENG-LV GmbH, specializes in architectural lighting. The company's website indicates offerings in products, manufacturing, sales, projects, and downloads, suggesting a comprehensive approach to lighting solutions. Their focus on architectural lighting positions them within the design and manufacturing sectors for specialized lighting fixtures.

name: WIGGERT & Co. GmbH
summary: WIGGERT & Co. GmbH is a German company specializing in the development and production of custom concrete mixing and transport systems for the international market. With over 50 years of experience, they offer innovative engineering solutions, advanced concrete technologies, and comprehensive lifecycle support for the industrial manufacturing of various concrete products. Their mission is to partner with clients to meet future challenges in concrete production through quality, innovation, and reliability.

name: ADOH B.V.
summary: ADOH B.V. is a Dutch pharmaceutical manufacturer and service provider, operating as part of the DADA group. The company specializes in providing marketing authorization services, acting as a formal holder for medicinal products for non-European and European pharmaceutical companies. They also offer batch release and testing, GMP/GLP/GDP/GCP/GVP auditing services, and manufacturing and importation authorization.

name: DKP Express
summary: DKP Express is an asset-based expedited and hotshot carrier established in 2012, specializing in time-critical deliveries across the US using a fleet of small and large straight trucks. They offer courier, white glove, and hand-carry services, focusing on supply chain solutions for large companies needing fast and reliable deliveries. DKP Express has been recognized for its rapid growth, ranking on the INC 5000 lists.

name: Johnny Air Cargo
summary: Johnny Air Cargo is a logistics and freight forwarding company specializing in shipping services from the US to the Philippines. They offer air freight, online shopping assistance, door-to-door delivery, and package consolidation. Their mission is to provide reliable, efficient, and affordable shipping solutions, connecting individuals and businesses across borders.

name: GLS
summary: GLS is a parcel delivery service operating primarily in the US, offering services like parcel shipping, rate calculation, and tracking. They focus on providing flexible pickup options, integrations with partners, and competitive pricing, particularly for business shippers. GLS also emphasizes environmental sustainability in its logistics operations and has a strong presence in wine shipping.

name: Arietis Corporation
summary: Arietis Corporation is a biotechnology company focused on developing novel small molecule antibiotics to combat drug-resistant bacterial pathogens. Their proprietary technology activates the ClpP protease, leading to bacterial self-digestion and effective killing of resistant strains, including ESKAPE pathogens and Streptococcus pneumoniae. This approach aims to treat complex infections like prosthetic joint infections and endocarditis, addressing a significant unmet clinical need in antimicrobial resistance.

name: Incyte
summary: Incyte is a global biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of innovative medicines for patients with unmet medical needs. The company's primary therapeutic areas include oncology and dermatology, with a strong emphasis on scientific excellence and innovation. Incyte operates globally, with a presence in multiple countries, and is dedicated to improving patient lives through its research and development efforts.

name: DeepTechXL Venture Capital
summary: DeepTechXL is a venture capital fund specializing in deep-tech investments, established in 2022 to fortify the Dutch deep-tech ecosystem. It leverages the expertise and networks of tech corporates, knowledge institutes, and impact investors. The fund focuses on technologies addressing key societal themes and contributing to the UN SDGs, providing ventures with funding, hands-on support, and access to a valuable ecosystem.

name: Fireside Ventures
summary: Fireside Ventures is an investment firm focused on backing early-stage, digital-first consumer brands in India with the goal of scaling them globally. They manage significant capital and have invested in over 62 portfolio companies, emphasizing brands that are purpose-led and aim to do good while achieving commercial success. The firm also provides resources and insights through its 'Fireside Ignite' platform to help founders.

name: KFC Ventures
summary: KFC Ventures is an investment firm that provides seed and growth-stage funding to B2B startups focused on creating revolutionary changes. As a branch of the Nityo Group, they aim to empower businesses with funds and expert guidance to achieve their goals. Their focus areas include Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, BFSI, Technology, and Security.

name: Purple Arch Ventures
summary: Purple Arch Ventures is a private investing community for Northwestern University alumni, offering both a diversified venture fund and deal-by-deal syndications. It focuses on investing in cutting-edge ventures, co-investing alongside leading venture capital firms, and providing members with access to venture deals with low minimums and shared due diligence. The community aims to leverage collective investment power for strategic exposure to venture capital.

name: AEROINT
summary: AEROINT delivers world-class defence, aviation, and security solutions, combining global expertise with local insight. They specialize in advanced defence and security systems, aviation security and compliance, cyber security, and turnkey defence industry services. The company aims to transform defence and security challenges into actionable solutions, empowering clients to achieve operational superiority and maintain readiness.

name: Envisioneering, Inc.
summary: Envisioneering, Inc. is a small business with 30 years of experience dedicated to mission support and technology development for U.S. national defense. They provide innovative solutions to government and commercial clients, employing experts in science, engineering, and analysis to solve complex technical and operational problems. Their services span scientific research, advanced technology development across the electromagnetic spectrum, systems engineering, and specialized support for special operations aviation and mobility solutions.

name: TeamteQ
summary: TeamteQ is a company specializing in expert systems engineering services, particularly for the defense sector. They offer comprehensive solutions including C4I systems, system integration, and consultative services to enhance command and control, operational efficiency, and decision-making. With a focus on innovation and a proven track record, TeamteQ aims to elevate defense capabilities for its clients.

name: Ultra I&C
summary: Ultra I&C specializes in Command & Control (C2) platforms, tactical communications, and encryption solutions for defense and security sectors. Their offerings include mission software, edge compute, and optimization tools designed to fuse data across domains, providing commanders with real-time operational clarity. The company focuses on delivering resilient, secure, and high-speed communication and data processing capabilities for ground, sea, and air operations.

name: aBusiness Suite
summary: aBusiness Suite is a comprehensive business management platform designed for small and medium-sized enterprises. It digitizes core business areas including sales, email marketing, customer onboarding, and retention, leveraging over 200 AI-powered agents to enhance efficiency and quality. The platform aims to create robust, traceable processes, enabling businesses to operate smoothly even without constant owner oversight.

name: Creatio
summary: Creatio is a global software company that provides a leading no-code platform for building AI-powered applications and automating workflows. Their platform combines CRM functionalities with low-code/no-code development tools and AI capabilities, enabling businesses to accelerate time-to-value and achieve digital transformation. Creatio serves various industries, offering solutions for sales, marketing, and customer service automation.

name: knk Customer Engagement GmbH
summary: knk Customer Engagement GmbH provides intelligent and innovative software solutions for CRM, marketing automation, customer service, and business intelligence, specifically tailored for publishing houses and media companies. With 35 years of experience, they focus on optimizing sales processes, enhancing customer loyalty through cross-channel communication, and improving data analysis for better planning. Their offerings include knk365 suite for media sales, customer service, marketing automation, and BI, alongside AI products and integration frameworks.

name: Oracle
summary: Oracle is a global technology company providing integrated cloud applications and platform services. They offer a wide range of solutions including cloud infrastructure, database management, enterprise resource planning (ERP), human capital management (HCM), and customer relationship management (CRM). Oracle serves businesses of all sizes across various industries, aiming to help them innovate and grow through their comprehensive technology offerings.

name: Affordable Computer Solutions
summary: Affordable Computer Solutions provides comprehensive managed IT services, including network services, cloud solutions, VoIP, CCTV security, and website design. They focus on proactive monitoring, maintenance, and repair of IT infrastructure to ensure business continuity and growth. Their mission is to act as a dedicated IT department for businesses, allowing clients to concentrate on their core operations.

name: Devoteam
summary: Devoteam is a global technology consulting firm that drives business transformation through AI, cloud, data, and cybersecurity solutions. They partner with leading technology providers like AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft, and ServiceNow to offer a wide range of services including digital workplace, managed cloud services, and sustainable IT. The company focuses on helping clients innovate securely and responsibly, aiming to be a leader in enterprise technology.

name: ITonDemand
summary: ITonDemand provides comprehensive managed IT services, cybersecurity, compliance, and consulting nationwide. They offer a range of solutions including IT help desk support, network management, data backup, 24/7 monitoring, and proactive cybersecurity strategies. The company also assists organizations with IT compliance requirements for various industries and offers tailored service packages to meet diverse business needs.

name: Connectiv
summary: Connectiv is a leading managed ICT and Network services provider, acting as Telstra's No. 1 Platinum partner in Western Australia. They specialize in making complex IT environments simple for businesses by offering managed mobility, ICT, networks, and security services. Their integrated approach aims to be both an ICT and telco partner, providing comprehensive management of devices, platforms, users, and providers.

name: Integrated Technology Group
summary: Integrated Technology Group (ITG) provides comprehensive IT services and support, specializing in managed IT services, cloud integration, continuity planning, and cybersecurity solutions. They focus on helping medical practices optimize their systems, improve patient throughput, and maintain HIPAA compliance. ITG offers 24/7 monitoring and a guaranteed 1-hour response time for critical issues, positioning itself as a dedicated technology partner for healthcare providers.

name: TechOnsite
summary: TechOnsite is a managed IT services provider based in Los Angeles, specializing in offering proactive IT support, cybersecurity, and CIO solutions to small and medium-sized businesses. They aim to provide technology peace of mind by minimizing downtime, enhancing efficiency, and ensuring security, allowing clients to focus on business growth. Their services include managed IT, managed cybersecurity, and virtual CIO services.

name: BODE Fach-PR GmbH
summary: BODE Fach-PR GmbH is a specialized public relations and editorial service provider focusing on complex industrial, technical, and service-oriented topics, including international outreach. They offer services such as writing technical articles, editorial contributions, press releases, and developing tailored communication strategies. The company acts as an extended workbench for corporate press departments and an outsourced editorial team for trade publications and PR agencies, aiming to deliver high-quality content and impactful PR.

name: SEC Newgate EU
summary: SEC Newgate EU is a Brussels-based consultancy specializing in EU public affairs and public relations. As part of the global SEC Newgate Group, they offer a comprehensive suite of services including association management, digital communications, event management, government relations, media relations, policy communications, and stakeholder engagement. Their expertise lies in navigating EU institutions and shaping opinions for clients across various sectors.

name: Fairstone
summary: Fairstone is a full-service wealth management house offering intelligent financial solutions for clients' lifetime financial journeys. They provide independent financial advice, investment management, and estate planning services, incorporating one of the UK's largest Chartered financial planning firms. The company aims to help clients grow, plan, and protect their financial future, with a strong focus on client-centricity and whole-of-market choice.

name: Franklin Resources, Inc.
summary: Franklin Resources, Inc., operating as Franklin Templeton, is a global investment management organization. They offer a wide range of investment products and services, including mutual funds, ETFs, and alternative investment solutions, catering to both institutional and retail investors worldwide. The company focuses on providing investment expertise and financial solutions to help clients achieve their financial goals.

name: Fisher Investments
summary: Fisher Investments is an independent, fee-only investment advisory firm founded in 1979 by Ken Fisher. The firm manages over $386 billion in assets for more than 195,000 private and institutional clients globally. It specializes in tailored, goals-focused portfolio management and proactive client service, guided by Ken Fisher's investing philosophy.

name: NATAM
summary: NATAM is a management company based in Luxembourg that provides services to institutional investors, asset managers, and investment firms. Authorized under UCITS and AIFMD regimes, it offers investment management, risk management, legal compliance, administration, governance, and marketing support. As part of a banking group, NATAM emphasizes competence, accuracy, and reliability in its operations, aiming to understand and satisfy client needs with high-quality, bespoke financial services.

name: Nightingale Asset Management Asia
summary: Nightingale Asset Management Asia is an investment management firm specializing in providing tailored portfolio management and cryptocurrency services for affluent individual and institutional investors. They focus on a quality-driven, long-term investment approach, emphasizing rigorous processes, risk management, and client success. The firm offers services for individual, private, and institutional investors, alongside dedicated cryptocurrency solutions leveraging blockchain technology.

name: Palermo Wealth
summary: Palermo Wealth is an independent financial advisory firm offering personalized financial planning and ongoing investment management services. They differentiate themselves from traditional Wall Street firms, banks, and insurance companies by operating solely in the client's best interest as a fiduciary, without hidden costs or third-party commissions. Their mission is to help clients remove financial doubts, build trust, and achieve their goals with peace of mind.

name: CJ Campbell & Associates / CJC Wealth Management
summary: CJ Campbell & Associates and CJC Wealth Management are independent financial services firms focused on helping individuals achieve financial independence throughout retirement. They offer personalized retirement income strategies, long-term care planning, asset management, annuities, life insurance, and tax-efficient strategies. Their approach is disciplined, transparent, and tailored to each client's unique financial situation and goals, emphasizing a high standard of client servicing.

name: Flohr Asset Management
summary: Flohr Asset Management is an alternative investment specialist that provides exclusive wealth-management opportunities and customized financial strategies. They focus on offering clients access to a wide range of alternative investments not typically available through traditional firms, after conducting extensive due diligence. Their mission is to be a partner in successful investing by leveraging expertise and a broad network to deliver quality and diversified solutions.

name: Funghi Espresso
summary: Funghi Espresso is an agricultural startup that cultivates mushrooms using coffee grounds as a substrate, inspired by Blue Economy principles. They aim to transform waste into resources, producing mushrooms with minimal environmental impact through vertical farming and natural methods. The company offers various mushroom types and provides kits for home cultivation, emphasizing sustainability and taste.

name: SANANBIO
summary: SANANBIO is a global photobiotech supplier specializing in controlled environment agriculture solutions. They offer integrated systems for horticultural lighting, grow systems, and farm climate control, including turnkey solutions like the UPLIFT and RADIX Plant Factories. Their mission is to create controllable environments and artificial light sources to help growers yield more, positioning them as a key player in advanced horticultural technology.

name: The Vegetarian Butcher
summary: The Vegetarian Butcher is a leading global brand specializing in plant-based meat products designed to mimic the taste and texture of traditional butcher classics. Founded in 2010, the company aims to drive a worldwide food revolution by making plant-based eating accessible and delicious, positioning itself as a 'meat successor' rather than a substitute. Their mission emphasizes sustainability and reducing the environmental impact of food production by removing animals from the supply chain.

name: Winsect B.V.
summary: Winsect is a Dutch company operating a mealworm farm that converts waste streams into insect protein and organic fertilizers. They produce various fertilizer pellets from mealworm manure, emphasizing sustainability and zero emissions in their animal agriculture process. The company aims to establish insect farming as a common practice alongside traditional livestock farming.
